title: Animales de la granja y la selva
who: un nene de 6 (A2), frases muy cortas en ingles, mezcla espanol

transcripts.text: ¡Hola, aventurero! Soy Sparky, tu amigo dragón. ¡Hoy vamos a explorar el mundo y descubrir animales increíbles de la granja y la selva! Look, the big elephant is walking in the jungle.
Wow! I see el elefante big in la selva. It walk fasty!
You saw that big elephant! That is right, the big elephant is walking fast through the jungle. He is very strong, isn't he?
(sin respuesta)
He is very strong indeed! Say: The elephant is big and strong. Can you tell me what the elephant likes to eat?
(sin respuesta)
Elephants love to eat crunchy leaves and sweet fruit! Imagine you are a big elephant, what would you like to eat today?
¡Hola, soy Sparky! Estoy muy emocionado porque hoy vamos a explorar un mundo lleno de animales increíbles en la granja y la selva. Look, the big elephant is walking in the jungle!
(sin respuesta)
Oh, maybe you want to see the farm animals instead! Look, the small sheep is eating green grass. Can you tell me what you see in the farm?
(sin respuesta)
I see a happy cow in the farm! What about you, what animal do you see there?
(sin respuesta)
Oh, look at that! Maybe you can find a funny monkey in the jungle. I am looking for one, can you see a monkey playing in the trees?

¡Hola, amigo! Soy Sparky, tu dragón espacial. ¡Hoy vamos a una aventura increíble para conocer a los animales de la granja y de la selva! Mira, ahí veo a una vaca gigante. I see a big cow eating green grass.
Wow! I like la vaca, she says *moo moo* and eats grass. 🐮🌱
That is amazing! Yes, the big cow is eating the fresh grass. Can you see that fast monkey in the jungle tree over there?
I see el mono, he run very fastly! 😮🍌
That monkey is so fast, he runs quickly up the tree! Look, he is jumping from branch to branch.
He jump very quick! Yo quiero ser mono también.
You can be a monkey too! Look at him go, he is jumping really high. What would you do if you were a monkey in the jungle?
¡Hola, peque! Soy Sparky, tu amigo dragón. Hoy vamos a explorar el mundo y descubrir qué animales viven en la granja y cuáles en la selva. ¿Te gusta algún animal en especial?
(sin respuesta)
¡Hola, amigo! Por ejemplo, I like the big elephant in the jungle. ¿Cuál es tu animal favorito?
(sin respuesta)
Don't worry! Tell me, do you like the funny monkey or the big cow? You can say: I like the monkey.
(sin respuesta)
It is okay! Look at the green grass. The cow is eating grass in the farm. Can you say: The cow is in the farm?

¡Hola, aventurero! Soy Sparky, tu amigo dragón. Hoy tenemos una misión especial: vamos a explorar animales increíbles de la granja y la selva. ¿Te gustaría ver qué animal se esconde detrás de este arbusto?
Sí, profe! Quiero ver el animal, ¿es un pig o un mono?
¡Wow, qué buena pregunta! Vamos a mirar juntos. ¡Mira, es un cerdito muy juguetón, it is a little pig! Y él está muy feliz de verte hoy.
¡Me gusta pig! Es muy cute y dice oink.
That pig is very cute, and it says oink. I am really into the little pig because he is so happy, what do you think about him?
I think he is muy happy y cute. I love su oink, es funny.
That is a great point, his sound is so funny. He is very happy because he is eating, look at him go!
